title: Lithic footer
description: A quiet white footer: six columns of small grey links under black medium headings (a column can hold two groups), then a bottom row with the caps wordmark, centred grey legal lines and a few social icons. Two columns on phones. Links darken to black on hover.
notes: columns are lists of groups, so 'Products' and 'Platform' can share the first column
name: lithic-footer

props.name: columns
props.description: up to six columns; each holds one or more groups

props.name: wordmark
props.description: the company name, set as a bold caps wordmark

props.name: mark
props.description: a small mark before the wordmark (e.g. a lucide icon)

props.name: legal
props.description: the legal lines in the middle of the bottom row

props.name: socials
props.type: { label: string; href: string; icon: ReactNode; }[]
